entities.summary: "I'm Like a Bird" is a song by Canadian singer-songwriter Nelly Furtado. It was written by Furtado and produced by Gerald Eaton and Brian West for her debut studio album, Whoa, Nelly! (2000). Inspired by her first serious relationship in her early twenties, the folk-pop song reflects her experiences of isolation and emotional uncertainty while living alone in Los Angeles. Composed largely on guitar, much of the track was written in a brief, inspired session, which Furtado later described as an unexpected creative breakthrough.
